claim: The owner, of Gravesend's ghost train, which was one sector dressed in sprites: make it of sectors that share one motion, its ceiling included, so that it feels solid and not cut out of paper. We build our vehicles so; ours, not his words: only one member carries the voice.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-24, of a train that was one sector dressed in sprites: 'we should be able to make it out of sectors if they will share same motion it will work ... more solid and not feeling like cut out of paper' (bloodmap/mechanism.py rigid_body docstring); its ceiling must move with it (projects/blood-city/references/phantom-terminus-design.md, 'As rebuilt'). Blind readers had scored the sprite train 4 for recognition in ghost-station critique rounds 1-4 and none called it paper; only the owner's ride did.
One voice is our practice, not his words: projects/blood-city/level/motion_sounds.py VOICE ('one body of many sectors has one voice')
use: Build with rigid_body and carry_fittings; read back with motion_sim.rigid_bodies and body_health.

checked.how: mechanism.py:1326-1328 (rigid_body docstring) quotes the owner 2026-11-24: 'we should be able to make it out of sectors if they will share same motion it will work ... more solid and not feeling like cut out of paper'. phantom-terminus-design.md:72-76 'As rebuilt': its ceiling must move with it (paraphrase). ghost-station critique rounds 1-4 reviews.json: recognition score 4 each, no 'paper' in any review. motion_sounds.py:71 VOICE, :93-94 one voice.
